column1: # UNREVIEWED. No speaker of this language has read this file.
# The entries below were produced without a speaker's review, and some of
# them are wrong in ways only a speaker would catch -- a real word used for
# the wrong thing reads as confidently as a right one. The rest of the
# interface is deliberately NOT filled in: a line left out falls through to
# English, and English is better than invented technical vocabulary put into
# the mouth of a living language.
# So this is a starting point for a speaker to correct, not a translation.
# The picker says so, so that choosing it is an informed choice.
# To help: each line is english<TAB>translation, and tools/add_translations.py
# checks the file every way it can be broken silently.
# english<TAB>translation. A line left out, or left empty, falls through to the
# English -- so an unfinished catalogue is a partly translated app rather than
# Broadcast vocabulary is deliberately left in English where the trade leaves
